title: Horror Short Film “Slaughterbots” | ALTER
summary: Slaughterbots, a short dystopian film in which swarms of small autonomous drones are programmed to kill targets matching a profile. It opens as a slick product launch before turning into a terror scenario.
why: Used as a reference point in discussions of autonomous weapons, as a once-sci-fi scenario that now looks prescient.

quote.text: Quick reminder of the "Slaughterbots" video from 9(!) years ago, when the content was still sci-fi.
